opportunities.title: NASA International Space Apps Challenge 2026

opportunities.title: Schwarzman Scholars – Class of 2027–2028 (U.S./Global Application)
opportunities.description: A fully funded one-year Master's in Global Affairs at Tsinghua University in Beijing, designed to build a global network of leaders with deep understanding of China. Includes tuition, travel, room and board, and a stipend.
opportunities.eligibility: Applicants must hold an undergraduate degree, be between 18 and 29 years old as of the enrollment year, and demonstrate leadership, academic ability, and intercultural competency.

opportunities.funding: Fully funded (tuition, travel, room and board, stipend)

opportunities.title: Google Summer of Code 2026
opportunities.description: A global program pairing students and open-source beginners with mentoring organizations to work on a 12+ week open-source coding project over the summer, with a stipend on successful completion.
opportunities.eligibility: Must be at least 18 years old, a student or open-source beginner, eligible to work in their country of residence, and not from a U.S.-embargoed country.
opportunities.deadline_note: Contributor application window for the 2026 cycle closed April 8, 2026. This listing is shown as a reference for the program's structure; the 2027 cycle is expected to open around March 2027, but the exact date has not yet been confirmed by Google.
opportunities.funding: Paid stipend (amount varies by country tier)
